title: someone starts something without opening a shop

criteria.text: A Member with no Page can create a hosted gathering: no business record, no document/ID/ZIP check; F082 agreement is the only thing before publish
criteria.note: `startDraftAction` → `group.create` makes a draft from the kind alone; `group_businesses` row only for kind business; `group.activate` needs name, place, description and the F082 agreement [V]. Nothing guards "no check" Checked: unmarked: `src/app/create/actions.test.ts`. Reviewed: yes (#326).

criteria.text: First question is what they're starting; no self-classification anywhere
criteria.note: `/create` heading "What are you starting?", four radios [V]. But the answers read "Have a business where you sell…?", "Do you manage a group…?" (Don's wording, 2026-10-04/05): scenario says "no self-classification". Route is `/create`, not `/you/create` Checked: unmarked: `WhatAreYouStarting.test.tsx`. Reviewed: yes (#326).

criteria.text: No legal/tax language or legal-entity questions at Page creation
criteria.note: No such words in Create, draft checklist or rules text [V grep]; no field asks for entity info. Nothing guards it for Create (F082's rules text has its own test) Reviewed: yes (#326).

criteria.text: Second Page is one tap from the end of the first; first unchanged
criteria.note: Create is in the bottom nav on every screen (T158, #55) and "Start something" on /you; `group.create` only inserts a new draft [V]. No test of the one-tap path from a Page or of the first staying unchanged; deploy of #58 unconfirmed

criteria.text: `/you/sell` redirects to `/you/create` preserving the query string
criteria.note: `/you/sell/page.tsx` does `redirect('/create')` (#336, #392): target path differs and the query string is dropped. The venue "host here" link used `?compose=gathering&location=…`, now sent to bare `/create`. No test of the redirect. #392 was `review-skipped`
